title: Revealing the flame retardancy of cotton fabrics treated with ammonium ethylenediamine tetramethylenephosphonate and trimethylol melamine
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10522-10531
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00402K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yong-Man Jang, Chol-Jin Kim, Ju-Yong Kim, Dae-Hyok Mun, Chol-Jun Yu
Ammonium ethylenediamine tetramethylenephosphonate (AEDTMP) as a flame retardant and trimethylol melamine (TMM) as a binder were synthesized and applied to form a multilayer coating on cotton with ab initio calculations for their binding.
